svg.text: mr-kebabski. The night manager of "Kebab & Parking". A huge man, 1.95 m and heavy, armed with a full doner on its 2.1 m spit. 212 px = 1 m.

g.text: tips; the steel cap of his

svg.text: * A big, heavy man: 1.95 m, wide shoulders, round belly, double chin. Moves slowly
until he charges. Proud and theatrical: he is the manager and this is HIS kitchen.
* Slicked-back black hair with grey temples, waxed handlebar mustache, heavy-lidded
bored eyes, red bow tie, burgundy waistcoat with gold buttons, "NIGHT MANAGER" badge.
* White dress shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbow, hairy forearms with a red heart
tattoo, gold watch and ring. Long white apron with the K&P logo and grease stains.
* Weapon: a 2.1 m doner spit with a whole doner still on it: crank handle, leather grip,
drip tray, steel cap. He uses it as a lance (charge) and a club (spin).
* Rig: humanoid, scaled 1.08 tall and ~1.3 wide; belly and chin jiggle; spit is a 2-hand
prop with its own bone (the doner spins slowly in idle). HP 400. ~25k tris.
"Tonight's special does not leave the kitchen."
Defeated: a last dizzy spin, then he falls into a giant tray of fries.

g.text: Red line first, then a lance run. 30 dmg.
Stuck in a car: x2 damage.
50% HP: rings the bell, 2 cooks come.
Falls into a giant tray of fries.
